name: Kannami Seiji
source:
“Please don’t hate those kids.”

An associate pastor at the church next to the school grounds. He’s the only adult the kids of the Ghost Tower get along with. He’s friendly and understanding towards everyone, but occasionally he shows a delinquent side unbefitting his position. When he saw Makihara was on his own after moving for his new job, he started to worry about him. He grew up at the same orphanage as Kuboya, who for some reason acts aloof around him.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
